title: Beneath Cursed Tides
start: Speak to Wizard Myrtle at the fountains in front of the Wizards' Tower.

recommended.t: Access to the fairy ring network (members only)
Slayer cape for teleporting to Vannaka (members only)
Wilderness sword 1 or better for teleporting to Edgeville, or activated the Edgeville lodestone

rewards.t: 10000 Combat XP lamp in a choice of scl | Attack , scl | Constitution , scl | Strength , scl | Defence , scl | Ranged , scl | Prayer , scl | Magic , scl | Necromancy , scl | Herblore , scl | Slayer , or scl | Summoning (Skill must be level 10 or higher)
Vannaka's Sword, a sword override similar to that of Vannaka's steel two-handed sword which can be held in one hand
Lev's old music box – crumbles to dust when played, unlocking Newbie Melody (original)
Access to the Giant Oyster, a monthly Distraction and Diversion that provides scl | Fishing and scl | Farming experience
Looting the Giant Oyster will reward the player with items from the Treasure Trail reward tables

steps.t: Talk to Wizard Myrtle at the fountain near the entrance to the Wizards' Tower. (Fairy ring DIS) [Chat: 2 [Continue] › Accept › 1 I know Vannaka!]
Go to the Edgeville Mausoleum just south of the bank and talk to Vannaka. [Chat: 1 Talk about Beneath Cursed Tides. › 4 [Continue...] › 1 Yes, I do.]
Return to the Wizards' Tower, and talk to Wizard Myrtle. [Chat: 2 What's the plan then? › 1 How do I get to Mudskipper Point?]
Make your way to Mudskipper Point. The fastest route is via fairy ring AIQ. Alternatively, you can run south from the Port Sarim lodestone.
Unequip your weapons and dismiss followers and then talk to Wizard Myrtle. [Chat: 1 Sounds perfect, let's do this! › 2 I'd like to dive to the sunken island. › 1 Yes, I'm ready.]

sub.t: If you have completed the Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Pirate Pete subquest, or have built any kind of diving suit in the Aquarium. [Chat: 1 Sounds perfect, let's do this. › 1 Underwater breathing spell. › 2 I'd like to dive to the sunken island. › 1 Yes, I'm ready.]

steps.t: East of the room, read the message in the bottle for the key and open the door.
Talk to Brynna, the survival expert (directly to the south).
Catch two raw shrimps.
Gather the seaweed nearby.
Cut a tree to get a soggy branch.
Interact with the boulder to push it into the hole.
Cook both shrimp on the steam vent (two squares west of the boulder) to receive two boiled shrimps.
Boil 1 shrimp again to burn it. Keep one boiled shrimp.
Talk to Brynna twice.
Continue through the west gate.
Go to the building to the west and talk to the master chef.
Go to the large jellyfish south-east of the chef's house and play the music box. [Chat: 2 Turn second handle. › 3 Turn third handle. › 1 Turn first handle.]
Gather tasty seaweed.
Talk to the master chef again.
Prepare the large table 3 times by matching the 3 tastes with 3 ingredients (large table is in the same house).
Continue through the west door to the small house in the north.
Climb down the ladder.
Talk to mining instructor. [Chat: 1 Absolutely! › 3 Good bye.]
Mine soggy copper ore and soggy tin ore.
Click the furnace [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Right click and close the doors.
Operate the pump and light the furnace.
Retrieve the bronzish bar from the furnace.
Smith a bronze dagger.
Talk to the mining instructor again.
Continue through the east gate.
Talk to Vannaka, the combat instructor. [Chat: 1 Sure, I'm up for a challenge. › 2 Let's get on with the task.]
Open the gate and click on the sword in the middle of the room to begin combat training.
Click on the rats and other elements bouncing on the screen.
Exit the cage and climb the ladder to the north-east.
Talk to the financial advisor in the house directly to the east. [Chat: 1 Can we skip to the task?]
Enter the vault (the code is 139).
Talk to the financial advisor again.
Leave through the 2 doors to the east.
Head south to the church through double doors.
Talk to Brother Brace.
Read the friend list.
There will be 2 fish just east of the bank and the 3rd fish west of the bank, back through the two doors leading through the bank.
One of the five fish will tell you where the book is. Search for it.
Give the book to Brother Brace.
Go through the south door to the south-east building and talk to Wizard Terrova. [Chat: 1 I certainly am. › 1 Can you give me some runes to cast this 'strike of air'?]
Attack a chicken.
Talk to the wizard.
Pick any option during the cutscene.
Channel the spell while repelling Crassians.
Finish Hector Vivian.
Talk to Wizard Myrtle. [Chat: 1 We did it!]
Quest complete!
